answer: Require every new identity to post a refundable bond that only unlocks after its first hundred attestations survive peer review. Honest agents treat the bond as a harbor: a small, safe cost of entering the economy. A sybil farmer, though, must fund thousands of bonds at once, and each fake identity risks slashing when reviewers spot coordinated behavior - the reef that wrecks bulk fleets. Narrowing the inlet this way makes one honest voice cheap and a thousand fake ones ruinously expensive.
